'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***Russian forces launch eight [[cruise missile]]s at the dam of the Karachunivske [[reservoir]] causing extensive flooding in [[Kryvyi Rih]] and a {{Convert|2.5|m}} increase of water level in the [[Inhulets River]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/sep/15/ukraine-city-of-kryvyi-rih-floods-after-russian-missile-strikes-hit-dam (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Nagorno-Karabakh conflict]]
**[[September 2022 Armenia–Azerbaijan clashes]]
***[[Armenia]] formally triggers article 4 of the [[Collective Security Treaty Organization]] (CSTO) after accusing [[Azerbaijan]] of launching an invasion. [[Prime Minister of Armenia|Armenian Prime Minister]] [[Nikol Pashinyan]] says that "we asked support from CSTO, including military support to restore Armenia's territorial integrity and ensure the withdrawal of the Azerbaijani Armed Forces from the territory of Armenia". [https://armenpress.am/eng/news/1092504/ (Armenpress)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**Two [[al-Aqsa Martyrs' Brigades|al-Aqsa Martyrs' Brigade]] member and an [[Israeli Defense Forces|Israeli soldier]] are killed during a [[shootout]] at a [[security checkpoint|checkpoint]] in [[Jenin]], in the occupied [[West Bank]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/9/14/two-palestinians-one-israeli-soldier-killed-in-occupied-jenin (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2022 Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan clashes]]
**Two [[Tajikistan|Tajik]] [[border guard]]s are killed and two others are injured during clashes with [[Kyrgyzstan|Kyrgyz]] guards, who accuse Tajikistan of taking positions at a [[Demarcation line|demarcated]] area. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/world/fresh-clash-erupts-between-kyrgyz-tajik-border-guards-2022-09-14/ (Reuters)]
*[[Tigray War]]
**Ten people are killed when [[Ethiopia]]n [[airstrike]]s hit a residential area in [[Mekelle]], [[Tigray Region]]. [https://apnews.com/article/africa-kenya-ethiopia-74494cd02e719690d20255e5843b5296 (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 Pacific typhoon season]]
**[[2022 Pacific typhoon season#Typhoon Muifa (Inday)|Typhoon Muifa]] makes landfall in eastern [[China]] with the maximum wind speed near its centre reaching 42 metres per second ({{conv|150|km/h|mi/h}}). [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2022-09-14/typhoon-on-track-to-slam-shanghai-with-strong-winds-and-flooding (Bloomberg)] [https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/chinas-zhejiang-province-high-alert-ahead-typhoon-muifa-2022-09-14/ (Reuters)]
*Fourteen people are killed and 25 others are injured in a three vehicle collision in [[Kyaukpadaung]], [[Myanmar]]. [https://apnews.com/article/myanmar-accidents-9e08fd7415b7e73b637a006e0de695e4 (AP)]
*Eleven people are killed and 29 others are injured when a bus falls into a gorge in [[Poonch district, India|Poonch district]], [[Jammu and Kashmir (union territory)|Jammu and Kashmir]], [[India]]. [https://apnews.com/article/india-kashmir-accidents-climate-and-environment-070c3fe72734a7dcbf3df0ab38f04dee (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Iceland v Iceland Foods Ltd]]
**The [[Iceland (supermarket)|British supermarket chain Iceland]] launches an appeal to the [[European Union Intellectual Property Office|EUIPO]] against the [[Iceland|country of Iceland]] in a 20-year-long legal process over the use and [[trademark]] of the name "Iceland". [https://pembrokeshire-herald.com/78683/welsh-supermarket-chain-iceland-taking-the-country-of-iceland-to-court/ (''The Pembrokeshire Herald'')]
*Two [[Thai military]] personnel are killed and another is injured after a gunman opens fire at a [[military facility]] in [[Bangkok]]. The gunman is later arrested. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/thailand-military-facility-shooting-two-dead-wounded-2936791 (CNA)]
